name: Cerilis
source:
The combined form of [url=/c83639]Ailis[/url] and [url=/c83640]Cerise[/url].

Stars like her are born from the soul of deceased humans, with her specifically being born from the soul of [url=/c83638]Einar[/url]'s mother. Because of Einar's grudge against the stars for failing to heal her mother's illness, she was cursed to be born as two separate halves.

Only by Einar accepting the two halves as they are could Cerilis become whole.
